items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day code injection vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler,' allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-92 (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update addresses an unauthenticated customer account takeover vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that allows attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction, and has been added to CISA's KEV catalog.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw was found in the popular Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento.
